en: "Where's Elpina?"{w}
"I couldn't say. She's probably gone off hunting for junk again..."{w}
"...I'm right here."{w}
"What?!"{w}
"Y-you've been up there all this time?!"{w}
note: sonna tokoro = 'a place like that'; Elpina's reply (up top) settles it as 'up there'.

en: "Yep. I was just napping up top. Didn't you notice?"{w}
"Don't tell me... just now, you..."{w}
note: Hess fears she overheard the talk with Gurtia (end of slice 003); kept as a trailing fragment, 'you' supplied.

en: "Mmm... well, yeah.{w}More importantly, is this okay? There's a bunch of people who've been peeking at us from over there for a while now."{w}
note: yatsura = the player party; kept neutral ('a bunch of people').

en: "What?!"{w}
"Ah, it's you guys!!"{w}
"You showed up at just the right time. Hey, Mirco! Show 'em what all that training got you!"{w}
"Yeah!"{w}
"I shall wash away our last defeat with your blood!"{w}
"...So, Sis, what are you gonna do? Just watch again today?"{w}
note: nee-san (Elpina's name for Gurtia, not a blood relation) = 'Sis' throughout.

en: "What?! I..."{w}
"Hate to admit it, but these guys are the kind we can't beat unless we go all out.{w}Mind lendin' us a hand?"{w}
note: Editorial: 'Won't you lend us a hand?' was too polite for Zapper's rough voice (te wo kashite kurenee ka); matched his g-dropping elsewhere.

en: "Yes, please. With you here, our fighting strength would surely be on solid footing."{w}
note: Accuracy: "finally" dropped (not in source); to iu mono = "naturally/surely".

en: "Gurtia!"{w}
"Young master..."{w}
note: bocchama = 'young master'.

en: "I'm asking you too.{w}When you're by my side, Gurtia, I can fight without getting nervous."{w}
"Hey, hey, Mirco?"{w}
note: Mirco-kun: the kun is dropped (no natural English equivalent).

en: "What?"{w}
"Mirco, do you like Sis?"{w}
"Do you looove her?"{w}
"Of course I do! ...W-why are you asking all of a sudden?"{w}
"You heard him, Sis! Good for you~"{w}
note: Music note dropped (ASCII only). Accuracy: music note restored as "~" per lead convention (review_notes).

en: "Wh-why, you..."{w}
note: Editorial: 'Y-you are just...' was unnatural English for the flustered 'anata nee...'; trail-off kept.

en: "What's the matter, you two?"{w}
note: Editorial: 'What's wrong with you two?' reads as an accusation; Mirco is innocently puzzled (dou shita no).

en: "Sis. Mirco is Mirco, you know?{w}Sure, I was only listening in, but even so... that story makes me sick to my stomach."{w}
note: Elpina overheard Gurtia's grievance against House Lenzer (slice 003): Mirco is not to blame. munakuso warui kept strong. Editorial: 'even for me, just listening to it' was clumsy; strength of munakuso warui kept.

en: "I'm sure you've got feelings you can't take out on anyone.{w}But... you don't actually mind being his wet nurse all that much, do you?"{w}
note: uba = wet nurse (glossary position for Gurtia). manzara demo nai = not as unwelcome as she claims. Editorial: 'feelings with nowhere to go' was a literal calque; the stray 'either' obscured manzara demo nai (not as unwelcome as she claims).

en: "When you're mending Mirco's clothes, or making those chocolate cornets he loves, Sis, you look like you're having a really great time~"{w}
note: choco cornet = chocolate cornet (horn-shaped pastry).

en: "Or is that just my imagination?"{w}
"That's enough!!"{w}
"What have you two been talking about this whole time?"{w}
"See, see? You're confusing poor Mirco, Sis."{w}
"..........{w}...This will cost you dearly, Elpina."{w}
"Hehe. If you need to vent, I'll listen as long as it takes!"{w}
note: Elpina turns 'this will cost you' into an offer to hear Gurtia's grumbling.

en: "Oh, that's right, Hess.{w}There is one thing I should tell you, so there is no misunderstanding.{w}A word in your ear..."{w}
note: Hess-sama rendered plain "Hess" (lead convention: no honorific while Hess's gender is unknown); Mirco-sama = "Master Mirco" (glossary).

en: "What is it?"{w}

(When I see something cute... I just can't help wanting to torment it and watch it squirm.){w}{p}(I do not think well of the House. However...{w}where Master Mirco is concerned, my own personal tastes come into it as well...){w}{p}(So please do not let it trouble you too much.{w}...Hee hee hee!!){w}
note: Whispered aside; parentheses kept. oie = House Lenzer. Editorial: 'a matter of personal taste' means 'subjective' in English and hid her meaning (her own predilection). Ufufufu rendered 'Ufufufu!!' to match Gurtia's laugh in slice 005 (:884), not the girlish 'Hee hee'. PRF: en already follows the lead convention 'Hee hee (hee)' for Gurtia's katakana laugh; the note above is stale.

en: (...Now I'm all the more worried.){w}
Gurtia took up her whip.{w}
"Now then, let us clear away this unsightly trash quickly, shall we, young master?"{w}
"Thanks, Gurtia!{w}All right, this time we're gonna beat 'em to a pulp!!"{w}
note: kechon-kechon = thoroughly trounce.

en: "N-not even all of us together can win...?"{w}

"Tch.
We've got ourselves one hell of a rival."{w}
"But it was the first time we all fought together!"{w}
"Indeed!{w}This sense of unity reminds me of my days in the knightly order!!"{w}
"You guys are really strong.{w}We lost again this time, but let's have a rematch someday! Next time, we'll win!"{w}
"We meet again!{w}You know, I've actually started looking forward to fighting you guys."{w}
"Just like you've been growing, I've gotten stronger too! Now, have at you!!"{w}

"Ow ow ow...
I guess I really can't beat you that easily..."{w}
"But I'm not giving up! Someday I'll overtake you, I swear!{w}Until then, don't you dare lose to anyone!"{w}
"Hmm... where on earth are we?!{w}And that lot is here as well."{w}
note: ayatsura = the player party (dream/bonus encounter). Editorial: 'rascals' added a judgement; ayatsura is only mildly dismissive (accuracy item).

en: "How very bizarre..."{w}
"Feels kinda weird. Like I've got my five senses, but also like I don't..."{w}
"I get it, this has gotta be a dream!"{w}
"Whoa...{w}Oh, I know!{w}If this is a dream, maybe we can win!"{w}
"There you go again..."{w}
"Why not?{w}We can't avoid a fight either way, I'd imagine."{w}
"All right, let's go all out~!"{w}
note: Music note replaced with ~ (ASCII only).

en: "We lost again...{w}But it's fine if it's a dream, right?"{w}
"What kind of attitude is that?!"{w}
"Well, it's a dream."{w}
"Then I'm the Hell Master, dream or not!!"{w}
note: Riffs on Zephal's catchphrase 'I am the Hell Master!' (glossary).

en: "Eeeeek!?"{w}
"Dreaming that I'm in a dream with everyone...{w}How curious."{w}
"Not to sound like Mirco, but is this one of those deals where we wake up and it's like none of it ever happened?"{w}
note: Mirco ja nee kedo read as 'not to sound like Mirco' (asking a naive question).

en: "So we won't remember any of it either?"{w}
"I see, it won't stay in anyone's memory.{w}I seeee.{w}...Heh heh heh!"{w}
"Huh? Zephal?"{w}
"Ha ha ha, is that so! Nobody will remember!{w}Then it's fine for me to cut loose, isn't it!?"{w}
"Y-yeah. I guess it's fine, but..."{w}
"Heh... heh heh heh..."{w}{p}"Fwahahaha! Then let us march to battllllle!{w}Follow me, follow meeeeee, you hear!{w}Smash it allllll! Woo-hoooooo!!"{w}
note: Zephal switches from watashi to ore here (losing his composure); conveyed by the unhinged register.

en: Zephal ran off, swinging his sword around.{w}
"Z-Zephal... what's gotten into you?"{w}
"Aww, just leave Zephal be~"{w}
note: Drawled -o; Zapper is going strange too (see slice 005).
